name: Oxfam lower frontage
observations: Native177 clearly shows green OXFAM branding on a light fascia beside cardfactory.
Light/metal-framed double entrance and display glazing beneath red-brick upper windows.
Pavement has merchandise/tool props nearby, but some belong to neighbouring DIY frontage.
Part of the shared B038 retail upper mass; do not create another full building behind the lower bay.
Keep charity sign as independent geometry/material and avoid cloning the large Food Warehouse wall lettering onto it.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
